T: Break into Alcatraz. Break out the snacks.
D: An FBI chemist and a former SAS man break into Alcatraz to stop a rogue general.
P: Serve the snacks when Mason gets his haircut at the hotel.
S: Sourdough with olive oil and dukkah
Warm torn sourdough with salted butter and olive oil dukkah for dipping
Sourdough warmed at 200C for 8 minutes, torn, with salted butter and a dish of olive oil and dukkah.
San Francisco, looking out at the island

Creamy chowder of clams, bacon, potato, onion and thyme, ladled into small hollowed sourdough rolls toasted crisp, with oyster crackers on top. Steam 1kg clams in 250ml white wine until open, then remove the meat and strain the juice. Fry 4 diced bacon rashers, add 1 onion, 2 celery sticks and 2 diced potatoes and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp flour, then the clam juice, 300ml milk and thyme, and simmer 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender. Add 200ml cream and the clams. Hollow 4 small sourdough rolls, toast at 200C for 8 minutes and fill.
Prawns tossed in hot olive oil with garlic, chilli and butter
Prawns sautéed hot in olive oil with sliced garlic and chilli, finished with butter, white wine and parsley, sourdough for the pan juices.
M: San Francisco cioppino and garlic toast
the city's own seafood stew, across the bay from the Rock

Fennel, garlic and chilli simmered in tomato and white wine with prawns, mussels, clams and snapper, served with charred garlic sourdough. Soften 1 sliced fennel bulb, 1 onion and 4 garlic cloves in olive oil with a pinch of chilli flakes. Add 250ml white wine, 400g crushed tomatoes and 500ml fish stock and simmer 20 minutes. Add 500g clams and 500g mussels, cover 3 minutes, then 400g snapper chunks and 12 green prawns for 4 minutes more until everything is cooked. Finish with parsley. Grill thick sourdough slices rubbed with garlic and olive oil.
Rib eye with béarnaise and chips
Butter-basted rib eye, tarragon béarnaise and twice-fried chips
Dry-brined rib eye seared and basted with butter, thyme and garlic, rested, with béarnaise and double-fried frites.
W: Dense baked brownie squares with toasted walnuts
Melted dark chocolate and butter whisked into sugar and eggs, flour and toasted walnuts folded in, baked at 175C for 25 minutes, flaky salt on top, cut into squares.
K: Single malt Scotch stirred with sweet vermouth and bitters

Single malt Scotch stirred with sweet vermouth and bitters over ice, strained into chilled coupes with a cherry and a twist of orange. Chill 4 coupes. Fill a jug with ice, add 200ml single malt Scotch, 80ml sweet vermouth and 8 dashes aromatic bitters and stir for 30 seconds until icy. Strain into the coupes. Drop in a cocktail cherry and twist a strip of orange peel over each glass.

s.note: Warm sourdough with salted butter and oil with dukkah
s.how: Warm a sourdough loaf at 200C for 8 minutes and tear into chunks. Serve with 125g soft salted butter and a shallow dish of extra virgin olive oil with 3 tbsp dukkah scattered on top for dipping.

s.note: Garlic chilli prawns in butter and white wine, with bread
s.how: Heat 3 tbsp olive oil, add 5 sliced garlic cloves and 1 sliced chilli, then 600g peeled green prawns. Toss over high heat for 2 minutes. Add 60g butter, a splash of white wine and parsley. Serve with bread for the juices.

m.note: Butter-basted rib eye with béarnaise and frites
m.how: Reduce 60ml white wine vinegar with tarragon to 2 tbsp, whisk with 3 yolks over low heat and drizzle in 200g warm clarified butter. Fry 1kg potato chips twice. Sear 4 rib eyes, baste with 40g butter, thyme and garlic, rest and serve.

w.note: Fudgy walnut chocolate squares with flaky salt
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 100g flour and 100g toasted walnuts. Bake in a lined tin at 175C for 25 minutes. Sprinkle with flaky salt, cool and cut into squares.
